items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: The lead trumpet player was Beech--who was the lead player?

ctx.x: He was there at one period. I don't remember too much about him, but he seemed to be all right. I don't have--I can't recall too much about Irv other than he
was there. The lead trumpet player was Beech--who was the lead player?
